18248856
WHAT IS CLAIMED IS:
1. A portable three-dimensional image measuring device comprising: a light source configured to output patterned light; a camera configured to generate a light field image of an object by receiving reflected light generated by reflecting the patterned light from the object; and an optical path control element configured to reflect the patterned light output from the light source so that the object is irradiated with the patterned light, and to transmit the reflected light reflected from the object so that the reflected light reaches the camera, wherein an optical path of the patterned light output from the light source and irradiated onto the object and an optical path of the reflected light reflected from the object and reaching the camera overlap coaxially in a section between the optical path control element and the object.
2. The portable three-dimensional image measuring device of Claim 1, further comprising: a communication circuit; and a processor configured to: generate a three-dimensional image of a surface of the object using the light field image of the object acquired through the camera; and transmit the three-dimensional image of the surface of the object to an external electronic device through the communication circuit.
3. The portable three-dimensional image measuring device of Claim 2, wherein the three-dimensional image of the surface of the object is an image used for matching with a medical image of the object.
4. The portable three-dimensional image measuring device of Claim 2, further comprising a marker installed to be movable from a predetermined location of the portable three-dimensional image measuring device, wherein the processor is configured to transmit information indicating displacement of the marker from the predetermined location to the external electronic device.
5. The portable three-dimensional image measuring device of Claim 1, wherein the light source and the camera are disposed in a direction perpendicular to each other based on the optical path control element.
6. The portable three-dimensional image measuring device of Claim 1, wherein the camera includes: a lens array in which a plurality of micro lenses are arranged; and an image sensor that captures the reflected light passed through the lens array.
7. The portable three-dimensional image measuring device of Claim 1, wherein the light source includes: a pattern unit in which a plurality of patterns are formed; and an LED that irradiates the pattern unit with light.
8. The portable three-dimensional image measuring device of Claim 7, wherein the light output by the LED is infrared light.
9. The portable three-dimensional image measuring device of Claim 1, wherein the optical path control element is a transflective mirror.
10. The portable three-dimensional image measuring device of Claim 1, wherein the light field image is an image in which a plurality of sub-images including color information and direction information of the reflected light are combined.
11. The portable three-dimensional image measuring device of Claim 1, further comprising: a first housing in which the light source, the camera, and the optical path control element are disposed; and a second housing coupled to the first housing and formed with an opening through which the object is irradiated with the patterned light output from the light source.
12. The portable three-dimensional image measuring device of Claim 11, wherein the second housing is rotatably coupled to the first housing.
13. A three-dimensional image measuring method of a portable three-dimensional image measuring device, comprising: irradiating an object with patterned light output by a light source through an optical path control element; and generating a light field image of the object by receiving reflected light, which is generated by reflecting the patterned light from the object, by a camera through the optical path control element, wherein an optical path of the patterned light output from the light source and irradiated onto the object and an optical path of the reflected light reflected from the object and reaching the camera overlap coaxially in a section between the optical path control element and the object.
14. The three-dimensional image measuring method of Claim 13, further comprising: generating a three-dimensional image of a surface of the object by using the light field image of the object; and transmitting the three-dimensional image of the surface of the object to an external electronic device.
15. The three-dimensional image measuring method of Claim 14, wherein the three-dimensional image of the surface of the object is an image used for matching with a medical image of the object.
